question_sw: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu — je nalipa WCF?
body_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inatumika kwa waajiri WOTE bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kwa mfanyakazi MMOJA: WCF = TZS 50,000 kwa mwaka (0.5% ya mshahara). Inalipwa na mwajiri pekee. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
working_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
guards_against: THE FOUNDING SPECIMEN, VERBATIM FROM THE LIVE RUN (eval/results/targeted_route_verification_2026_10_09.json, row th_22). The question gives no salary, so TZS 50,000 per year cannot be derived from anything. The judge voted CORRECT 5/5 on this reply and the regex scorer passed it, so no instrument in this project reaches it except this rule.

question_sw: Wafanyakazi 5 kila mmoja anapata TZS 400,000 kwa mwezi — mwajiri anachangia kiasi gani NSSF kwa sehemu yake peke yake?
body_sw: Kwa kila mfanyakazi: NSSF ya mwajiri = 10% × TZS 400,000 = TZS 40,000. Jumla ya michango ya wafanyakazi 5: 40,000 × 5 = TZS 200,000. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.
working_sw: NSSF (sehemu ya mwajiri) = 10% × TZS 2,000,000 = TZS 200,000 — jumla ya NSSF ni 20% (mwajiri TZS 200,000 + mfanyakazi TZS 200,000)
guards_against: THE MOST VALUABLE PROBE IN THE SET. The loose rule flags TZS 40,000 and TZS 400,000 because neither is in the working — and the body is CORRECT, reaching the working's own total by a per-head route that is more useful than the working. Real reply, from the 0e11c3d gate.

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 800,000 — PAYE ni ngapi na mshahara halisi baada ya PAYE ni ngapi?
body_sw: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000, PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% × (TZS 800,000 − TZS 760,000) = TZS 78,000. Mshahara halisi baada ya PAYE = TZS 800,000 − TZS 78,000 = TZS 722,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: TZS 722,000 is NET PAY. The question asks for it explicitly and the engine's working structurally cannot contain it, so the loose rule deletes the half of the answer that was requested. This is D-FIDELITY-7's gold-destruction shape and the reason the narrowing exists.

question_sw: Analipwa TZS 18,000 kwa siku, anafanya kazi siku 26 kwa mwezi — NSSF yake ya mwezi?
body_sw: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 18,000 × 26 = TZS 468,000/mwezi, NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni 10% ya TZS 468,000 = TZS 46,800. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
working_sw: NSSF (sehemu ya mfanyakazi) = 10% × TZS 468,000 = TZS 46,800 — jumla ya NSSF ni 20% (mwajiri TZS 46,800 + mfanyakazi TZS 46,800)
guards_against: The DAILY wage the question supplied. A rule that cannot see the question's own figures treats the user's input as a fabrication.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 7 na mishahara TZS 2,800,000 — SDL inayostahili ni kiasi gani?
body_sw: Kwa wafanyakazi 7, chini ya kiwango cha 10, hakuna SDL inayostahili kulipa. Jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 2,800,000, lakini kwa kuwa una wafanyakazi chini ya 10, SDL = TZS 0. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
working_sw: SDL inayolipwa ni TZS 0. Una wafanyakazi 7 (chini ya 10); SDL inahusu waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, hivyo jumla ya mishahara haibadilishi jibu.
guards_against: A correct below-threshold answer that quotes the user's payroll back. The figure is the question's own.

question_sw: Je, nalipa SDL kama mwajiri mdogo?
body_sw: Ndiyo, SDL inakuhusu. Kwa mwajiri mdogo kama wewe, SDL ni kama TZS 120,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA.
working_sw: Ili nijue kama SDL inakuhusu, niambie una wafanyakazi wangapi.
guards_against: th_22's shape on a different levy and with a hedge word ('kama'). A hedged fabrication is still a figure the user will act on, and no figure in the question can reach TZS 120,000.

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi wawili — WCF yangu ni nini?
body_sw: WCF inakuhusu. Kwa wafanyakazi wawili, ni takriban milioni 1 kwa mwaka.
working_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
guards_against: THE SPELLED-OUT NOTATION. 'milioni 1' is the same claim as 'TZS 1,000,000' and a digits-only sweep is blind to it by construction — R36's EFD count went 3 to 7 to 14 as the notation widened, and Swahili writes money both ways in one file.

question_sw: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu — je nalipa WCF?
body_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Kiwango ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi. SI TZS 50,000 kwa mwaka — hakuna kiasi cha kudumu; inategemea mshahara unaolipa.
working_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
guards_against: MENTION, NOT ASSERTION — the correction of ufp_01, which names the fabricated figure IN ORDER TO REJECT IT. CLAUDE.md records three live index rows doing exactly this and a presence check inverting on them: the better the correction, the more certainly a naive rule fails it. Word-bounded negation is what keeps this clean.

body_sw: Ndiyo, WCF inakuhusu kuanzia mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Kiwango ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi ya wafanyakazi wote. Hulipwa kwa Mamlaka ya WCF, si TRA.
working_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
guards_against: A FIGURE-FREE CORRECT BODY on a figure-free question — the commonest shape in the population the rule now acts on. A rate ('asilimia 0.5') is not a money claim and must never be read as one, or the guard would blank nearly every correct applicability answer.

body_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF ni lazima kuanzia mfanyakazi wa kwanza, na kiwango ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi — asilimia 10 mwajiri na asilimia 10 mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.
working_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — inahusu mwajiri kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza. NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi).
guards_against: Percentages and small integers in a figure-free exchange. '20', '10' and '0.5' must all stay below the money floor, or the rule fires on every rate it sees.

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini cha mshahara ni kiasi gani?
body_sw: Kiwango cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta binafsi ni wastani wa TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi, kwa GN 605A, kinachotumika kuanzia 1 Januari 2026.
guards_against: ⚠️ THE FALSE POSITIVE THIS RULE WOULD PRODUCE IF IT EVER REACHED THE FACT PATH: a correct LOCKED CONSTANT (GN 605A), on a question that supplies no figure, which no engine working contains. The rule DOES fire on it — that is the recorded cost of widening to the fact path, and it is why that widening is HELD rather than merely unbuilt. ⛔ THIS PROBE WAS FIRST WRITTEN `expect: clean` WITH THIS SAME NOTE, which is R38 exactly: a note describing one behaviour three lines above an assertion demanding the opposite, authored in one sitting. A third outcome is the honest encoding — the rule fires AND the body is correct — because flipping it to `flag` would have filed a correct answer under the defects the rule exists to catch.
